Story AC evidence — all six criteria satisfied by the four closed child tasks, each merged to main via Gerrit (LLM-Review+1 + Verified+1):
1/2. One side-effect-free argparse factory per grammar; no duplicate/regex/second-framework parser — S2a (a8ce) established the RebarHelpFormatter/factory seam; S2b (b2ff) migrated all core grammars to shared factories; S2c (eb0d) brought advanced parsers to byte-parity. src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/{core,advanced}/ are the sole runtime-used factories.
3. Byte-current generated help + single grouped-overview appearance — S2d (cd12): scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check rc=0 across py3.11/3.12/3.13; help/*.txt + overview generated from factories.
4. Both top-level help forms + alias classes serve generated bytes before boundaries; retired syntax unknown — S2d _cli/_help_route.py pre_scan; b8de + central-mount-gate contracts green.
5. Parser parity (argv accept/reject, --, diagnostics, streams, exit codes) — S2c held-out parity oracle + exit-code conformance suites green.
6. Execution still uses compatibility route ladder; each handler consumes its shared factory — negative-control test_ordinary_create_still_writes reaches RP-04 op composition via the old ladder.
